{{RV|type=function

|game1= arma2
|version1= 1.00

|game2= arma2oa
|version2= 1.50

|game3= tkoh
|version3= 1.00

|game4= arma3
|version4= 0.50

|gr1= Arrays

|descr= This function is similar to the array push function; however, it pushes the contents of an array onto the stack array.
{{Feature|arma3|Use [[append]] or [[pushBack]] instead}}

|s1= [array1, array2] call [[BIS_fnc_arrayPushStack]]

|p1= array1: [[Array]]

|p2= array2: [[Array]]

|r1= [[Array]] - the modified ''array1''

|x1= <sqf>
private _array = [0,1,2];
[_array, [3,4,5]] call BIS_fnc_arrayPushStack; // _array is [0,1,2,3,4,5]
</sqf>

|x2= <sqf>private _array = [[5, 6, 7], [8, [9], 10]] call BIS_fnc_arrayPushStack; // _array is [5, 6, 7, 8, [9], 10]</sqf>

|seealso= [[BIS_fnc_arrayPush]] [[pushBack]] [[append]]
}}
